#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared: Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster — Dark Dashboard Aesthetic (v3 — Final)
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle, Circle
import numpy as np
import os

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

intel_data = [
    ("Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", 57, "Google"),
    ("GPT-5.4 (xhigh)", 57, "OpenAI"),
    ("Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", 53, "Anthropic"),
    ("Muse Spark", 52, "Other"),
    ("Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)", 52, "Anthropic"),
    ("GLM-5.1", 51, "Other"),
    ("Grok 4.20 0309 v2", 49, "xAI"),
    ("Gemini 3 Flash", 46, "Google"),
    ("DeepSeek V3.2", 42, "DeepSeek"),
    ("NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super", 36, "NVIDIA"),
    ("gpt-oss-120B (high)", 33, "OpenAI"),
]

full_data = [
    {"name": "Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", "short": "Gemini 3.1 Pro",  "intel": 57, "speed": 129, "price": 4.50,  "provider": "Google"},
    {"name": "GPT-5.4 (xhigh)",       "short": "GPT-5.4",         "intel": 57, "speed": 72,  "price": 5.60,  "provider": "OpenAI"},
    {"name": "Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", "short": "Opus 4.6",        "intel": 53, "speed": 40,  "price": 10.00, "provider": "Anthropic"},
    {"name": "Claude Sonnet 4.6(max)","short": "Sonnet 4.6",      "intel": 52, "speed": 48,  "price": 6.00,  "provider": "Anthropic"},
    {"name": "GLM-5.1",               "short": "GLM-5.1",         "intel": 51, "speed": 40,  "price": 2.10,  "provider": "Other"},
    {"name": "Grok 4.20 0309 v2",     "short": "Grok 4.20",       "intel": 49, "speed": 162, "price": 3.00,  "provider": "xAI"},
    {"name": "Gemini 3 Flash",        "short": "Gemini 3 Flash",  "intel": 46, "speed": 149, "price": 1.10,  "provider": "Google"},
    {"name": "DeepSeek V3.2",         "short": "DeepSeek V3.2",   "intel": 42, "speed": 31,  "price": 0.30,  "provider": "DeepSeek"},
    {"name": "NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Sup", "short": "Nemotron 3 Sup",  "intel": 36, "speed": 193, "price": 0.40,  "provider": "NVIDIA"},
    {"name": "gpt-oss-120B (high)",   "short": "gpt-oss-120B",    "intel": 33, "speed": 206, "price": 0.30,  "provider": "OpenAI"},
]

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLORS — Dark Dashboard Aesthetic
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

BG          = "#0B0E14"
BG_CARD     = "#13171F"
BG_CARD2    = "#191E28"
TEXT        = "#E8ECF1"
TEXT2       = "#8B95A5"
TEXT3       = "#5C6678"
BLUE        = "#58A6FF"
TEAL        = "#3FB950"
AMBER       = "#F0883E"
PURPLE      = "#BC8CFF"
RED         = "#FF7B72"
CYAN        = "#39D2C0"
GOLD        = "#FFD700"
BORDER      = "#262D3A"
BORDER_L    = "#1E2430"

PROV_CLR = {
    "Google":    "#4285F4",
    "OpenAI":    "#34A853",
    "Anthropic": "#AF52DE",
    "DeepSeek":  "#FF6B6B",
    "xAI":       "#FF9500",
    "NVIDIA":    "#76B900",
    "Other":     "#8B949E",
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIGURE — A1 Portrait, 300 DPI
# 594mm × 841mm = 23.39" × 33.11"
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

DPI = 300
FW, FH = 23.39, 33.11

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FW, FH), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

# Main grid: title | stats | hero bubble | intel+speed | price+insights | method
gs_main = gridspec.GridSpec(6, 1, figure=fig,
    height_ratios=[0.05, 0.04, 0.38, 0.20, 0.20, 0.06],
    hspace=0.035,
    left=0.065, right=0.935, top=0.975, bottom=0.02)

ax_title  = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[0])
ax_stats  = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[1])
ax_bubble = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[2])

gs_mid = gridspec.GridSpecFromSubplotSpec(1, 2, subplot_spec=gs_main[3], wspace=0.24)
ax_intel = fig.add_subplot(gs_mid[0])
ax_speed = fig.add_subplot(gs_mid[1])

gs_low = gridspec.GridSpecFromSubplotSpec(1, 2, subplot_spec=gs_main[4], wspace=0.24)
ax_price    = fig.add_subplot(gs_low[0])
ax_insights = fig.add_subplot(gs_low[1])

ax_method = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[5])

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. TITLE BAR
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_title.set_facecolor(BG)
ax_title.set_xticks([]); ax_title.set_yticks([])
for s in ax_title.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)

# Top accent line
ax_title.axhline(y=1.0, xmin=0.0, xmax=1.0, color=BLUE, linewidth=6, alpha=0.6)

# Main title
ax_title.text(0.5, 0.65,
    "Frontier AI Models Compared",
    transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=62, fontweight='bold',
    color=TEXT, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

# Subtitle with accent colors per word
ax_title.text(0.5, 0.10,
    "Intelligence  ·  Speed  ·  Cost",
    transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=36, fontweight='bold',
    color=BLUE, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

ax_title.text(0.99, 0.10,
    "Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0",
    transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=16, color=TEXT3,
    ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. STAT CALLOUT BANNER — Three hero numbers
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_stats.set_facecolor(BG)
ax_stats.set_xticks([]); ax_stats.set_yticks([])
for s in ax_stats.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)

stats = [
    {"value": "57",  "unit": "AA Index",  "label": "Highest Intelligence\n(Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4)", "color": BLUE},
    {"value": "206", "unit": "tokens/sec", "label": "Fastest Output Speed\n(gpt-oss-120B)",            "color": TEAL},
    {"value": "33×", "unit": "",           "label": "Price Range Factor\n($0.30 → $10.00)",        "color": AMBER},
]

stat_w = 0.30
gap = 0.022
start_x = 0.5 - (3 * stat_w + 2 * gap) / 2

for i, st in enumerate(stats):
    x0 = start_x + i * (stat_w + gap)

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x0, 0.04), stat_w, 0.92,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.015", facecolor=BG_CARD,
        edgecolor=BORDER, linewidth=2,
        transform=ax_stats.transAxes, clip_on=False)
    ax_stats.add_patch(rect)

    # Top accent bar
    ax_stats.plot([x0 + 0.025, x0 + stat_w - 0.025], [0.92, 0.92],
        color=st["color"], linewidth=5, alpha=0.85,
        transform=ax_stats.transAxes, clip_on=False)

    # Big number
    ax_stats.text(x0 + stat_w/2, 0.64, st["value"],
        transform=ax_stats.transAxes, fontsize=54, fontweight='bold',
        color=st["color"], ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

    # Unit
    if st["unit"]:
        ax_stats.text(x0 + stat_w/2, 0.42, st["unit"],
            transform=ax_stats.transAxes, fontsize=16, color=TEXT2,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

    # Label
    ax_stats.text(x0 + stat_w/2, 0.18, st["label"],
        transform=ax_stats.transAxes, fontsize=11, color=TEXT3,
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', linespacing=1.3)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. BUBBLE CHART — THE HERO (38% of poster)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_bubble.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
for spine in ax_bubble.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER)
    spine.set_linewidth(1.5)

# Data
intel_b  = np.array([d["intel"] for d in full_data])
speed_b  = np.array([d["speed"] for d in full_data])
price_b  = np.array([d["price"] for d in full_data])
colors_b = [PROV_CLR[d["provider"]] for d in full_data]

# Bubble size: sqrt scaling (area ∝ price, bigger = more expensive)
bubble_s = [max(150, (p ** 0.45) * 400) for p in price_b]

# Subtle zone bands
ax_bubble.axhspan(0, 55, alpha=0.04, color=RED, zorder=0)
ax_bubble.axhspan(55, 130, alpha=0.04, color=AMBER, zorder=0)
ax_bubble.axhspan(130, 250, alpha=0.04, color=TEAL, zorder=0)

ax_bubble.text(63.5, 28, "SLOW", fontsize=13, color=RED, alpha=0.25,
    ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontweight='bold')
ax_bubble.text(63.5, 92, "MODERATE", fontsize=13, color=AMBER, alpha=0.25,
    ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontweight='bold')
ax_bubble.text(63.5, 170, "FAST", fontsize=13, color=TEAL, alpha=0.25,
    ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontweight='bold')

# Scatter
scatter = ax_bubble.scatter(intel_b, speed_b, s=bubble_s, c=colors_b,
    alpha=0.78, edgecolors='white', linewidths=2, zorder=5)

# ── Carefully positioned labels ──
# (short_name, bubble_x, bubble_y, label_x, label_y, ha, va, fs)
label_positions = [
    ("Gemini 3.1 Pro",  57, 129,  55, 150, 'right', 'bottom', 16),
    ("GPT-5.4",         57, 72,   60, 58,  'left',  'top',    16),
    ("Opus 4.6",        53, 40,   48, 22,  'center','top',    14),
    ("Sonnet 4.6",      52, 48,   56, 62,  'left',  'bottom', 14),
    ("GLM-5.1",         51, 40,   45, 58,  'right', 'bottom', 13),
    ("Grok 4.20",       49, 162,  51, 180, 'left',  'bottom', 16),
    ("Gemini 3 Flash",  46, 149,  41, 133, 'center','top',    15),
    ("DeepSeek V3.2",   42, 31,   42, 50,  'center','bottom', 14),
    ("Nemotron 3 Sup",  36, 193,  38, 212, 'left',  'bottom', 14),
    ("gpt-oss-120B",    33, 206,  31, 222, 'right', 'bottom', 15),
]

for short, bx, by, tx, ty, ha, va, fs in label_positions:
    ax_bubble.plot([bx, tx], [by, ty], color=TEXT3, linewidth=0.7, alpha=0.5, zorder=4)
    ax_bubble.text(tx, ty, short, fontsize=fs, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT,
        ha=ha, va=va, fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=6)

# Price micro-labels (inside/near bubbles)
for d in full_data:
    ax_bubble.text(d["intel"], d["speed"] - 2, f'${d["price"]:.2f}',
        fontsize=8.5, color=TEXT2, ha='center', va='top',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=7, alpha=0.7)

# ── Key insight annotations ──
# Arrow: Fastest ≠ Smartest
ax_bubble.annotate("",
    xy=(55, 72), xytext=(35, 200),

BG_CARD     = "#13171F"
BG_CARD2    = "#191E28"

TEXT3       = "#5C6678"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared: Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster — Dark Dashboard Aesthetic (v4 — Print-ready fonts)
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle, Circle
import numpy as np
import os

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

intel_data = [
    ("Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", 57, "Google"),
    ("GPT-5.4 (xhigh)", 57, "OpenAI"),
    ("Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", 53, "Anthropic"),
    ("Muse Spark", 52, "Other"),
    ("Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)", 52, "Anthropic"),
    ("GLM-5.1", 51, "Other"),
    ("Grok 4.20 0309 v2", 49, "xAI"),
    ("Gemini 3 Flash", 46, "Google"),
    ("DeepSeek V3.2", 42, "DeepSeek"),
    ("NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super", 36, "NVIDIA"),
    ("gpt-oss-120B (high)", 33, "OpenAI"),
]

full_data = [
    {"name": "Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", "short": "Gemini 3.1 Pro",  "intel": 57, "speed": 129, "price": 4.50,  "provider": "Google"},
    {"name": "GPT-5.4 (xhigh)",       "short": "GPT-5.4",         "intel": 57, "speed": 72,  "price": 5.60,  "provider": "OpenAI"},
    {"name": "Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", "short": "Opus 4.6",        "intel": 53, "speed": 40,  "price": 10.00, "provider": "Anthropic"},
    {"name": "Claude Sonnet 4.6(max)","short": "Sonnet 4.6",      "intel": 52, "speed": 48,  "price": 6.00,  "provider": "Anthropic"},
    {"name": "GLM-5.1",               "short": "GLM-5.1",         "intel": 51, "speed": 40,  "price": 2.10,  "provider": "Other"},
    {"name": "Grok 4.20 0309 v2",     "short": "Grok 4.20",       "intel": 49, "speed": 162, "price": 3.00,  "provider": "xAI"},
    {"name": "Gemini 3 Flash",        "short": "Gemini 3 Flash",  "intel": 46, "speed": 149, "price": 1.10,  "provider": "Google"},
    {"name": "DeepSeek V3.2",         "short": "DeepSeek V3.2",   "intel": 42, "speed": 31,  "price": 0.30,  "provider": "DeepSeek"},
    {"name": "NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Sup", "short": "Nemotron 3 Sup",  "intel": 36, "speed": 193, "price": 0.40,  "provider": "NVIDIA"},
    {"name": "gpt-oss-120B (high)",   "short": "gpt-oss-120B",    "intel": 33, "speed": 206, "price": 0.30,  "provider": "OpenAI"},
]

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLORS — Dark Dashboard Aesthetic
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

BG          = "#0B0E14"
BG_CARD     = "#13171F"
BG_CARD2    = "#191E28"
TEXT        = "#E8ECF1"
TEXT2       = "#9BA4B2"
TEXT3       = "#5C6678"
BLUE        = "#58A6FF"
TEAL        = "#3FB950"
AMBER       = "#F0883E"
PURPLE      = "#BC8CFF"
RED         = "#FF7B72"
CYAN        = "#39D2C0"
GOLD        = "#FFD700"
BORDER      = "#262D3A"

PROV_CLR = {
    "Google":    "#4285F4",
    "OpenAI":    "#34A853",
    "Anthropic": "#AF52DE",
    "DeepSeek":  "#FF6B6B",
    "xAI":       "#FF9500",
    "NVIDIA":    "#76B900",
    "Other":     "#8B949E",
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FONT SIZE GUIDE (points, for A1 at actual size)
# Title: 80pt, Section headers: 38pt, Body: 22pt
# Bar labels: 18pt, Annotations: 16pt, Captions: 14pt
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

F_TITLE    = 80
F_SUBTITLE = 40
F_HEADER   = 36
F_BODY     = 22
F_BAR      = 18
F_ANNOT    = 16
F_CAPTION  = 14
F_TICK     = 15
F_SMALL    = 12

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIGURE — A1 Portrait, 300 DPI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

DPI = 300
FW, FH = 23.39, 33.11

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FW, FH), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

gs_main = gridspec.GridSpec(6, 1, figure=fig,
    height_ratios=[0.055, 0.045, 0.36, 0.21, 0.21, 0.06],
    hspace=0.035,
    left=0.07, right=0.93, top=0.975, bottom=0.02)

ax_title  = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[0])
ax_stats  = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[1])
ax_bubble = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[2])

gs_mid = gridspec.GridSpecFromSubplotSpec(1, 2, subplot_spec=gs_main[3], wspace=0.26)
ax_intel = fig.add_subplot(gs_mid[0])
ax_speed = fig.add_subplot(gs_mid[1])

gs_low = gridspec.GridSpecFromSubplotSpec(1, 2, subplot_spec=gs_main[4], wspace=0.26)
ax_price    = fig.add_subplot(gs_low[0])
ax_insights = fig.add_subplot(gs_low[1])

ax_method = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[5])

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. TITLE BAR
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_title.set_facecolor(BG)
ax_title.set_xticks([]); ax_title.set_yticks([])
for s in ax_title.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)

# Top accent line
ax_title.axhline(y=1.0, xmin=0.0, xmax=1.0, color=BLUE, linewidth=6, alpha=0.55)

ax_title.text(0.5, 0.65,
    "Frontier AI Models Compared",
    transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=F_TITLE, fontweight='bold',
    color=TEXT, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

ax_title.text(0.5, 0.08,
    "Intelligence  ·  Speed  ·  Cost",
    transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=F_SUBTITLE, fontweight='bold',
    color=BLUE, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

ax_title.text(0.99, 0.08,
    "Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0",

    ax_insights.text(0.11, y - 0.03, ins["body"],

# Bottom callout
rect = FancyBboxPatch((0.04, 0.01), 0.92, 0.13,

    "There is no single \"best\" model —\nthe right choice depends on which dimension matters most.",
    transform=ax_insights.transAxes, fontsize=F_BODY-2, fontweight='bold',
    color=AMBER, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif',
    linespacing=1.4)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_method.set_facecolor(BG_CARD2)
ax_method.set_xticks([]); ax_method.set_yticks([])
for spine in ax_method.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER)
    spine.set_linewidth(1)

ax_method.plot([0.004, 0.004], [0.1, 0.9],
    color=BLUE, linewidth=6, transform=ax_method.transAxes, clip_on=False)

ax_method.text(0.022, 0.82, "About the Index",
    transform=ax_method.transAxes, fontsize=F_BODY+2, fontweight='bold',
    color=TEXT2, va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

ax_method.text(0.022, 0.55,
    "10 Evaluations: GDPval-AA · τ²-Bench Telecom · Terminal-Bench Hard · SciCode · AA-LCR · AA-Omniscience · IFBench · Humanity's Last Exam · GPQA Diamond · CritPt",
    transform=ax_method.transAxes, fontsize=F_SMALL, color=TEXT3,
    va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', linespacing=1.4)

ax_method.text(0.022, 0.25,
    "All measurements conducted independently by Artificial Analysis using standardized conditions. Pricing is USD per 1M tokens (blended input/output).",
    transform=ax_method.transAxes, fontsize=F_SMALL, color=TEXT3,
    va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', linespacing=1.4)

ax_method.text(0.975, 0.15,
    "Source: artificialanalysis.ai",
    transform=ax_method.transAxes, fontsize=F_CAPTION, fontweight='bold',
    color=BLUE, ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

output_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)

fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=DPI, facecolor=fig.get_facecolor(),
    edgecolor='none', pad_inches=0.1)

plt.close(fig)
print(f"Poster saved to {output_path}")

from PIL import Image
img = Image.open(output_path)
print(f"Image size: {img.size[0]}x{img.size[1]} pixels")
print(f"File size: {os.path.getsize(output_path) / 1024 / 1024:.1f} MB")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Frontier AI Models Compared: Intelligence, Speed & Cost
A1 Portrait Poster — Dark Dashboard Aesthetic (v4 — Print-ready fonts)
"""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Rectangle, Circle
import numpy as np
import os

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

intel_data = [
    ("Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", 57, "Google"),
    ("GPT-5.4 (xhigh)", 57, "OpenAI"),
    ("Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", 53, "Anthropic"),
    ("Muse Spark", 52, "Other"),
    ("Claude Sonnet 4.6 (max)", 52, "Anthropic"),
    ("GLM-5.1", 51, "Other"),
    ("Grok 4.20 0309 v2", 49, "xAI"),
    ("Gemini 3 Flash", 46, "Google"),
    ("DeepSeek V3.2", 42, "DeepSeek"),
    ("NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super", 36, "NVIDIA"),
    ("gpt-oss-120B (high)", 33, "OpenAI"),
]

full_data = [
    {"name": "Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview", "short": "Gemini 3.1 Pro",  "intel": 57, "speed": 129, "price": 4.50,  "provider": "Google"},
    {"name": "GPT-5.4 (xhigh)",       "short": "GPT-5.4",         "intel": 57, "speed": 72,  "price": 5.60,  "provider": "OpenAI"},
    {"name": "Claude Opus 4.6 (max)", "short": "Opus 4.6",        "intel": 53, "speed": 40,  "price": 10.00, "provider": "Anthropic"},
    {"name": "Claude Sonnet 4.6(max)","short": "Sonnet 4.6",      "intel": 52, "speed": 48,  "price": 6.00,  "provider": "Anthropic"},
    {"name": "GLM-5.1",               "short": "GLM-5.1",         "intel": 51, "speed": 40,  "price": 2.10,  "provider": "Other"},
    {"name": "Grok 4.20 0309 v2",     "short": "Grok 4.20",       "intel": 49, "speed": 162, "price": 3.00,  "provider": "xAI"},
    {"name": "Gemini 3 Flash",        "short": "Gemini 3 Flash",  "intel": 46, "speed": 149, "price": 1.10,  "provider": "Google"},
    {"name": "DeepSeek V3.2",         "short": "DeepSeek V3.2",   "intel": 42, "speed": 31,  "price": 0.30,  "provider": "DeepSeek"},
    {"name": "NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Sup", "short": "Nemotron 3 Sup",  "intel": 36, "speed": 193, "price": 0.40,  "provider": "NVIDIA"},
    {"name": "gpt-oss-120B (high)",   "short": "gpt-oss-120B",    "intel": 33, "speed": 206, "price": 0.30,  "provider": "OpenAI"},
]

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COLORS — Dark Dashboard Aesthetic
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

BG          = "#0B0E14"
BG_CARD     = "#13171F"
BG_CARD2    = "#191E28"
TEXT        = "#E8ECF1"
TEXT2       = "#9BA4B2"
TEXT3       = "#5C6678"
BLUE        = "#58A6FF"
TEAL        = "#3FB950"
AMBER       = "#F0883E"
PURPLE      = "#BC8CFF"
RED         = "#FF7B72"
CYAN        = "#39D2C0"
GOLD        = "#FFD700"
BORDER      = "#262D3A"

PROV_CLR = {
    "Google":    "#4285F4",
    "OpenAI":    "#34A853",
    "Anthropic": "#AF52DE",
    "DeepSeek":  "#FF6B6B",
    "xAI":       "#FF9500",
    "NVIDIA":    "#76B900",
    "Other":     "#8B949E",
}

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FONT SIZE GUIDE (points, for A1 at actual size)
# Title: 80pt, Section headers: 38pt, Body: 22pt
# Bar labels: 18pt, Annotations: 16pt, Captions: 14pt
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

F_TITLE    = 80
F_SUBTITLE = 40
F_HEADER   = 36
F_BODY     = 22
F_BAR      = 18
F_ANNOT    = 16
F_CAPTION  = 14
F_TICK     = 15
F_SMALL    = 12

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FIGURE — A1 Portrait, 300 DPI
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

DPI = 300
FW, FH = 23.39, 33.11

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FW, FH), dpi=DPI, facecolor=BG)

gs_main = gridspec.GridSpec(6, 1, figure=fig,
    height_ratios=[0.055, 0.045, 0.36, 0.21, 0.21, 0.06],
    hspace=0.035,
    left=0.07, right=0.93, top=0.975, bottom=0.02)

ax_title  = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[0])
ax_stats  = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[1])
ax_bubble = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[2])

gs_mid = gridspec.GridSpecFromSubplotSpec(1, 2, subplot_spec=gs_main[3], wspace=0.26)
ax_intel = fig.add_subplot(gs_mid[0])
ax_speed = fig.add_subplot(gs_mid[1])

gs_low = gridspec.GridSpecFromSubplotSpec(1, 2, subplot_spec=gs_main[4], wspace=0.26)
ax_price    = fig.add_subplot(gs_low[0])
ax_insights = fig.add_subplot(gs_low[1])

ax_method = fig.add_subplot(gs_main[5])

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. TITLE BAR
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_title.set_facecolor(BG)
ax_title.set_xticks([]); ax_title.set_yticks([])
for s in ax_title.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)

# Top accent line
ax_title.axhline(y=1.0, xmin=0.0, xmax=1.0, color=BLUE, linewidth=6, alpha=0.55)

ax_title.text(0.5, 0.65,
    "Frontier AI Models Compared",
    transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=F_TITLE, fontweight='bold',
    color=TEXT, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

ax_title.text(0.5, 0.08,
    "Intelligence  ·  Speed  ·  Cost",
    transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=F_SUBTITLE, fontweight='bold',
    color=BLUE, ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

ax_title.text(0.99, 0.08,
    "Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.0",
    transform=ax_title.transAxes, fontsize=F_SMALL, color=TEXT3,
    ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. STAT CALLOUT BANNER
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_stats.set_facecolor(BG)
ax_stats.set_xticks([]); ax_stats.set_yticks([])
for s in ax_stats.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)

stats = [
    {"value": "57",  "unit": "AA Index",  "label": "Highest Intelligence\n(Gemini 3.1 Pro & GPT-5.4)", "color": BLUE},
    {"value": "206", "unit": "tokens/sec", "label": "Fastest Output Speed\n(gpt-oss-120B)",            "color": TEAL},
    {"value": "33×", "unit": "",           "label": "Price Range Factor\n($0.30 → $10.00)",        "color": AMBER},
]

stat_w = 0.30
gap = 0.022
start_x = 0.5 - (3 * stat_w + 2 * gap) / 2

for i, st in enumerate(stats):
    x0 = start_x + i * (stat_w + gap)

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x0, 0.04), stat_w, 0.92,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.015", facecolor=BG_CARD,
        edgecolor=BORDER, linewidth=2,
        transform=ax_stats.transAxes, clip_on=False)
    ax_stats.add_patch(rect)

    # Top accent bar
    ax_stats.plot([x0 + 0.025, x0 + stat_w - 0.025], [0.92, 0.92],
        color=st["color"], linewidth=6, alpha=0.85,
        transform=ax_stats.transAxes, clip_on=False)

    # Big number
    ax_stats.text(x0 + stat_w/2, 0.64, st["value"],
        transform=ax_stats.transAxes, fontsize=60, fontweight='bold',
        color=st["color"], ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

    # Unit
    if st["unit"]:
        ax_stats.text(x0 + stat_w/2, 0.42, st["unit"],
            transform=ax_stats.transAxes, fontsize=F_CAPTION, color=TEXT2,
            ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

    # Label
    ax_stats.text(x0 + stat_w/2, 0.17, st["label"],
        transform=ax_stats.transAxes, fontsize=F_SMALL, color=TEXT3,
        ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', linespacing=1.3)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. BUBBLE CHART — THE HERO
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_bubble.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
for spine in ax_bubble.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER)
    spine.set_linewidth(1.5)

intel_b  = np.array([d["intel"] for d in full_data])
speed_b  = np.array([d["speed"] for d in full_data])
price_b  = np.array([d["price"] for d in full_data])
colors_b = [PROV_CLR[d["provider"]] for d in full_data]

# Bubble size: sqrt scaling (bigger = more expensive)
bubble_s = [max(200, (p ** 0.45) * 500) for p in price_b]

# Subtle zone bands
ax_bubble.axhspan(0, 55, alpha=0.035, color=RED, zorder=0)
ax_bubble.axhspan(55, 130, alpha=0.035, color=AMBER, zorder=0)
ax_bubble.axhspan(130, 250, alpha=0.035, color=TEAL, zorder=0)

ax_bubble.text(64, 28, "SLOW", fontsize=F_ANNOT, color=RED, alpha=0.25,
    ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontweight='bold')
ax_bubble.text(64, 92, "MODERATE", fontsize=F_ANNOT, color=AMBER, alpha=0.25,
    ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontweight='bold')
ax_bubble.text(64, 170, "FAST", fontsize=F_ANNOT, color=TEAL, alpha=0.25,
    ha='right', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif', fontweight='bold')

# Scatter
scatter = ax_bubble.scatter(intel_b, speed_b, s=bubble_s, c=colors_b,
    alpha=0.78, edgecolors='white', linewidths=2.5, zorder=5)

# ── Carefully positioned labels ──
label_positions = [
    ("Gemini 3.1 Pro",  57, 129,  54, 152, 'right', 'bottom', F_BAR),
    ("GPT-5.4",         57, 72,   60, 56,  'left',  'top',    F_BAR),
    ("Opus 4.6",        53, 40,   48, 18,  'center','top',    F_BAR),
    ("Sonnet 4.6",      52, 48,   57, 63,  'left',  'bottom', F_BAR),
    ("GLM-5.1",         51, 40,   44, 58,  'right', 'bottom', F_BAR-2),
    ("Grok 4.20",       49, 162,  51, 182, 'left',  'bottom', F_BAR),
    ("Gemini 3 Flash",  46, 149,  39, 131, 'center','top',    F_BAR),
    ("DeepSeek V3.2",   42, 31,   42, 52,  'center','bottom', F_BAR),
    ("Nemotron 3 Sup",  36, 193,  38, 214, 'left',  'bottom', F_BAR),
    ("gpt-oss-120B",    33, 206,  29, 224, 'right', 'bottom', F_BAR),
]

for short, bx, by, tx, ty, ha, va, fs in label_positions:
    ax_bubble.plot([bx, tx], [by, ty], color=TEXT3, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.45, zorder=4)
    ax_bubble.text(tx, ty, short, fontsize=fs, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT,
        ha=ha, va=va, fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=6)

# Price micro-labels
for d in full_data:
    ax_bubble.text(d["intel"], d["speed"] - 2.5, f'${d["price"]:.2f}',
        fontsize=F_SMALL-2, color=TEXT2, ha='center', va='top',
        fontfamily='sans-serif', zorder=7, alpha=0.7)

# ── Key insight annotations ──
ax_bubble.annotate("",
    xy=(55, 72), xytext=(35, 200),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=AMBER, lw=3,
        connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.25', alpha=0.9))

ax_bubble.text(40, 152,
    "Fastest\n≠ Smartest",
    fontsize=F_HEADER-4, fontweight='bold', color=AMBER,
    ha='center', va='center', fontfamily='sans-serif',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor=AMBER,
        alpha=0.93, linewidth=2))

ax_bubble.annotate("Best Value",
    xy=(46, 149), xytext=(29, 118),
    fontsize=F_ANNOT+2, fontweight='bold', color=TEAL,
    fontfamily='sans-serif',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=TEAL, lw=2),
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.35', facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor=TEAL,
        alpha=0.9, linewidth=1.5))

# Axes
ax_bubble.set_xlabel("Intelligence Score (AA Index)", fontsize=F_BODY,
    fontweight='bold', color=TEXT2, fontfamily='sans-serif', labelpad=14)
ax_bubble.set_ylabel("Output Speed (tokens/sec)", fontsize=F_BODY,
    fontweight='bold', color=TEXT2, fontfamily='sans-serif', labelpad=14)
ax_bubble.set_xlim(26, 66)
ax_bubble.set_ylim(5, 238)
ax_bubble.tick_params(axis='both', colors=TEXT2, labelsize=F_TICK)
ax_bubble.grid(True, alpha=0.10, color=TEXT3, linestyle='--', zorder=0)

ax_bubble.set_title("The Intelligence–Speed–Cost Trade-Off",
    fontsize=F_HEADER, fontweight='bold', color=BLUE, loc='left', pad=22,
    fontfamily='sans-serif')

ax_bubble.text(0.99, 0.97,
    "Bubble size ∝ Price per 1M tokens (bigger = more expensive)",
    transform=ax_bubble.transAxes, fontsize=F_SMALL, color=TEXT3,
    ha='right', va='top', fontfamily='sans-serif', style='italic')

# Provider legend
prov_order = ["Google", "OpenAI", "Anthropic", "DeepSeek", "xAI", "NVIDIA", "Other"]
prov_handles = []
for p in prov_order:
    if any(d["provider"] == p for d in full_data):
        h = plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=PROV_CLR[p],
            markersize=14, label=p, linestyle='None')
        prov_handles.append(h)

leg = ax_bubble.legend(handles=prov_handles, loc='lower left',
    fontsize=F_ANNOT, framealpha=0.92, facecolor=BG_CARD, edgecolor=BORDER,
    labelcolor=TEXT2, ncol=1, borderpad=1.2, handletextpad=0.8)
leg.get_frame().set_linewidth(1.5)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. INTELLIGENCE RANKINGS
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_intel.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
for spine in ax_intel.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER)
    spine.set_linewidth(1.5)

ax_intel.set_title("Intelligence Rankings", fontsize=F_HEADER,
    fontweight='bold', color=BLUE, loc='left', pad=16, fontfamily='sans-serif')

y_pos = np.arange(len(intel_data))
scores = [s for _, s, _ in intel_data]
names_i = [n for n, _, _ in intel_data]
colors_i = [PROV_CLR[p] for _, _, p in intel_data]

bars = ax_intel.barh(y_pos, scores, color=colors_i, alpha=0.82,
    edgecolor='none', height=0.6, zorder=3)

ax_intel.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax_intel.set_yticklabels(names_i, fontsize=F_BAR-2, color=TEXT, fontfamily='sans-serif')
ax_intel.invert_yaxis()
ax_intel.set_xlim(25, 66)
ax_intel.tick_params(axis='x', colors=TEXT3, labelsize=F_TICK-3)
ax_intel.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
ax_intel.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.10, color=TEXT3, linestyle='--')

for i, score in enumerate(scores):
    ax_intel.text(score + 0.8, i, str(score), va='center', ha='left',
        fontsize=F_BAR-2, fontweight='bold', color=TEXT, fontfamily='sans-serif')

# Gold edge for tied leaders
for i in range(2):
    bars[i].set_edgecolor(GOLD)
    bars[i].set_linewidth(3)

ax_intel.text(57, -0.6, "TIED #1", fontsize=F_SMALL, fontweight='bold',
    color=GOLD, ha='center', fontfamily='sans-serif')

# 24-pt gap
ax_intel.annotate("24-pt gap",
    xy=(33, 10.3), xytext=(42, 10.3),
    fontsize=F_ANNOT-2, fontweight='bold', color=RED, fontfamily='sans-serif',
    va='center',
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=RED, lw=1.5))

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. SPEED COMPARISON
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

ax_speed.set_facecolor(BG_CARD)
for spine in ax_speed.spines.values():
    spine.set_color(BORDER)
    spine.set_linewidth(1.5)

ax_speed.set_title("Output Speed Comparison", fontsize=F_HEADER,
    fontweight='bold', color=TEAL, loc='left', pad=16, fontfamily='sans-serif')

speed_data = sorted(full_data, key=lambda d: d["speed"], reverse=True)
y_pos_s = np.arange(len(speed_data))
speeds  = [d["speed"] for d in speed_data]
names_s = [d["short"] for d in speed_data]
